No entity named 'Sharjah Union Coop' exists in the UAE. This appears to be an invented conflation of two distinct consumer cooperatives: Sharjah Cooperative Society (Sharjah Coop, founded 1977 in Sharjah) and Union Coop (founded 1982 in Dubai).
